annotations.title: One metric over time for one area

description:
One metric over time for one area, monthly: asking price, asking rent, gross
    yield, reduction share, new listings, or an index (repeat-sales, asking price,
    asking rent). Use it for "how has X moved". area_type is postcode_district (lowercase, e.g. 'w14'), local_authority (GSS code,
    e.g. 'E09000012'), county or country; area_code is that code. Free text is refused: call
    resolve_place first.

    `date_from` / `date_to` are YYYY or YYYY-MM. At most 240 monthly points, 100
    per page, `next_cursor` for the rest. Index rows with `is_forecast: true` are
    the index's projection, not observations; `basis.as_of` is the last OBSERVED
    month. Always say which months are forecast and never state a forecast as
    certain. Index series exist for all bedrooms only (repeat-sales runs to about
    Jul 2026) and only for districts and local authorities. Sold price, volume,
    the hedonic nowcast and ONS private rent are not served yet (`not_published`).

    Do NOT use it to value a property. It is free; covered=false or an upstream
    failure is not charged. Free.
name: area_series
title: One metric over time for one area
